rationale: This is a nonprofit content-hosting and contribution-licensing agreement, not a sales or subscription contract, so there is no 'buy vs. license' framing to obscure — the document is unusually explicit that all contributions are freely licensed (CC BY-SA/GFDL) and that Wikimedia merely hosts content it doesn't own. It leads with a plain-language summary, though the full legal text still runs long with disclaimers, a liability cap, and a broad at-will termination clause.
evidence_quotes: We reserve the right to suspend or end the services at any time, with or without cause, and with or without notice.
In no event shall our liability exceed one thousand U.S. dollars (USD 1000.00) in aggregate.
